record.notes: Published on the Office of the Prime Minister's website; the Office announced the publication on 13 Feb 2025. The report carries no date of its own, and a later OPM release dates the National AI Policy Recommendations Report to September 2024. Jamaica had not adopted a national AI policy as of 22 May 2026: after a Cabinet decision, the Minister responsible for science and technology reconvened a reconstituted 23-member Task Force on 19 Feb 2026 with mandates to deliver a draft national AI policy within six to nine months and a draft legislative framework within twelve months, building on these recommendations and a UNESCO Readiness Assessment. On 22 May 2026 the Minister directed the Task Force to give Cabinet an urgent recommendation on AI literacy and interim governance measures for public bodies.
